label: Late-Night Radio Errand
description: For one outing, Loser narrates his errand in a smoldering late-night radio DJ voice ("coming up next, a gentleman in aisle seven") in one uncut video. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Serenade the Winner's QB
description: Winner picks a slow jam (radio edit only), and Loser serenades a printed photo of the winner's starting QB with full feeling, on video. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Fully Clothed Walk of Shame
description: Loser takes a slow, dramatic walk of shame down his block in rumpled clothes, shoes in hand, while the winner narrates like a nature documentary and a leaguemate films. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Romantic Getaway Review: My Street
description: After bedtime, Loser posts a five-star review of his own street as a steamy romantic getaway, with at least five winking puns. A screenshot goes in the league chat.

label: You Know Where to Find Me
description: For one week, Loser signs off every message in the league chat with a winking "you know where to find me." The chat is the proof.

label: Learn the Smolder
description: After bedtime, Loser films attempts at a smoldering one-eyebrow raise until he lands it. The best take goes in the league chat.

label: Formal Toast With Winner's Pun Word
description: Winner picks a double-meaning word, and Loser delivers a formal 30-second toast to the winner that uses it at least three times, on video. The video goes in the league chat.

label: Top 5 Cringe Flirting Moments
description: Loser posts a ranked top-5 of his own worst flirting attempts, with a one-line review of each, in the league chat.

label: Winner's Produce Pin-Up
description: Winner picks a vegetable, and Loser photographs it in a glamour-shot pin-up pose in the produce aisle with a smoldering caption. The photo goes in the league chat.

label: Eau de Winner Perfume Ad
description: Loser films a 45-second slow-motion perfume commercial at the neighborhood park, whispering the name of a fake fragrance named after the winner. The video goes in the league chat.
